description: Source file implementing helper methods for Input Capture Unit (ICU) handling, including driver management, callbacks, and pin configuration for STM32 microcontrollers within a ChibiOS environment.

methods.name: finddigital_input_s
methods.description: Finds the digital_input_s structure associated with a given ICUDriver.

methods.name: icuWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on ICU width measurement event, triggers width listeners.

methods.name: icuPeriordCallBack
methods.description: Callback invoked on ICU period event, triggers period listeners.

methods.name: getAlternateFunctions
methods.description: Returns the GPIO alternate function number for a given ICU driver.

methods.name: getInputCaptureChannel
methods.description: Determines the ICU channel based on hardware pin.

methods.name: getInputCaptureDriver
methods.description: Returns ICUDriver pointer for a given hardware pin, or NULL if invalid.

methods.name: turnOnCapturePin
methods.description: Configures a hardware pin for ICU capture mode.

methods.name: addWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Registers a new ICU driver for a specific pin and configures it.

methods.name: removeWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Removes ICU driver registration and disables it.

methods.name: startInputDriver
methods.description: Starts ICU capture on a given digital_input_s, setting active high/low mode.
